_purpose: One scene, five styles, two mechanisms, one seed: ten candidates. Enough to test both phases end to end before a run that takes the evening. The scene is a game-cinematic beat with clear staging -- a full shot, low angle, one standing figure over a fallen one, an ice spire behind -- so every craft field has something to survive.

scenes.note: full shot, low angle, standing archer over a fallen armoured figure, ice spire and haze behind

mechanisms.label: source frame conditions the first 35% of the denoise
